---
name: Service implementation request
about: Request a new AWS service to be added
title: '[SERVICE] Add {Service Name} support'
labels: service, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Which AWS service?**
Service name: ___________

**Use case**
Why do you need this service? What will you use it for?

**Required operations**
Which operations are most important?
- [ ] List/Read (view resources)
- [ ] Create (create new resources)
- [ ] Update (modify resources)
- [ ] Delete (remove resources)
- [ ] Other: _______

**Priority**
- [ ] High - I need this for my project
- [ ] Medium - Would be nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just a suggestion

**Can you help implement it?**
- [ ] Yes, I can follow the CONTRIBUTING.md guide
- [ ] Maybe, with some guidance
- [ ] No, but I can test it

**Additional notes**
Any specific requirements or edge cases?
